Apple___Apple_scab: Apply Captan or Mancozeb every 7-10 days. Remove fallen leaves. Prune for airflow.
Apple___Black_rot: Prune 8 inches below lesion. Apply copper fungicide. Remove mummified fruit.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust: Apply myclobutanil at bud break. Remove nearby cedar trees if possible.
Apple___healthy: Healthy. Continue regular watering and balanced fertilization.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray: Apply strobilurin fungicide. Rotate crops. Use resistant hybrids.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_: Apply propiconazole early. Plant rust-resistant varieties.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight: Apply fungicide at first sign. Rotate crops. Bury crop residue.
Grape___Black_rot: Remove infected berries. Apply mancozeb or captan. Improve canopy airflow.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles): No cure. Remove and burn infected vines. Avoid pruning in wet weather.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo: Apply copper fungicide. Remove infected leaves.
Grape___healthy: Healthy. Maintain proper trellis and pruning.
Potato___Early_blight: Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb. Ensure proper spacing. Avoid overhead watering.
Potato___Late_blight: URGENT: Apply metalaxyl+mancozeb immediately. Destroy infected plants.
Potato___healthy: Healthy. Monitor for Colorado potato beetle.
Rice___Brown_spot: Apply tricyclazole or propiconazole. Improve soil potassium.
Rice___Hispa: Remove and burn affected leaves. Apply chlorpyrifos. Drain field.
Rice___Leaf_blast: URGENT: Apply tricyclazole immediately. Avoid excess nitrogen.
Rice___healthy: Healthy. Maintain proper water levels and fertilization.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot: Apply copper bactericide. Remove infected leaves. Avoid overhead irrigation.
Tomato___Early_blight: Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb. Mulch base. Remove lower infected leaves.
Tomato___Late_blight: URGENT: Apply metalaxyl fungicide. Remove all infected material immediately.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold: Improve ventilation. Apply mancozeb. Reduce leaf wetness.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot: Remove infected leaves. Apply chlorothalonil. Stake plants.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider: Apply neem oil or miticide. Increase humidity.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus: No cure. Remove infected plants. Control whitefly.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus: No cure. Remove plants. Disinfect tools. Control aphids.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot: Apply copper bactericide. Use disease-free seeds.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch: Remove infected leaves. Apply myclobutanil. Improve drainage.
Strawberry___healthy: Healthy. Watch for gray mold during fruiting.
Peach___Bacterial_spot: Apply copper fungicide at petal fall. Prune for airflow.
Peach___healthy: Healthy. Thin fruit for better air circulation.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew: Apply sulfur or potassium bicarbonate. Prune for airflow.
Soybean___healthy: Healthy. Monitor for aphids and spider mites.
Squash___Powdery_mildew: Apply neem oil. Remove infected leaves. Avoid overhead watering.
Wheat___healthy: Healthy. Monitor for aphids. Ensure adequate nitrogen.
Wheat___Yellow_rust: Apply propiconazole or tebuconazole immediately. Use resistant varieties next season.
Wheat___Brown_rust: Apply mancozeb or propiconazole. Monitor weekly in humid conditions.
Wheat___Loose_smut: Use certified smut-free seeds. Treat with carboxin or thiram before sowing.
Wheat___Powdery_mildew: Apply sulfur-based or triazole fungicide. Avoid excess nitrogen.
Wheat___Septoria: Apply azoxystrobin at flag leaf stage. Remove crop debris after harvest.
Sugarcane___healthy: Healthy. Maintain proper irrigation and balanced NPK.
Sugarcane___Red_rot: URGENT: Destroy infected stools. Use disease-free seed canes. Apply Bordeaux mixture.
Sugarcane___Rust: Apply propiconazole. Plant resistant varieties. Avoid overhead irrigation.
Sugarcane___Yellow_leaf: Use certified virus-free seed cane. Control aphid vectors with imidacloprid.
Sugarcane___Mosaic_virus: No cure. Remove infected plants. Control aphid vectors. Use resistant varieties.
Sugarcane___Bacterial_blight: Remove infected stalks. Apply copper bactericide. Use disease-free planting material.
Cotton___healthy: Healthy. Monitor for bollworm and whitefly. Maintain soil pH 6.0-7.5.
Cotton___Curl_virus: No cure. Remove infected plants. Control whitefly with thiamethoxam or imidacloprid.
Cotton___Bacterial_blight: Apply copper oxychloride. Remove infected parts. Avoid overhead irrigation.
Cotton___Fusarium_wilt: No cure. Remove infected plants. Improve drainage. Use resistant varieties.
Cotton___Alternaria_leaf_spot: Apply mancozeb or iprodione. Remove infected leaves. Avoid leaf wetness.
